Counsel for Applicant :- Narendra Kumar Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.

By means of the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.282 of 2023 at Police Station-Kishni, District-Mainpuri under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 of the D.P. Act.
The applicant is in jail since 03.05.2023.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 01.07.2023.

The following arguments made by Shri Narendra Kumar, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant,
which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned AGA-I from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
1. The applicant is the mother-in-law of the deceased.

sentences.text: 2. The applicant never demanded dowry or tortured the deceased nor did he interfere in the matrimonial life of the deceased and her husband.
The applicant resided separately.

3. The applicant is bereaved by the death of the daughter-in-law.
4. The deceased was a sensitive lady who was prone to extreme reactions even over trivial issues.
5. On the fateful day, in a fit of rage, the victim took an extreme step of ending her life after a minor altercation with the member of the household.
The deceased committed suicide by hanging.
6. The conclusion drawn in the post mortem report regarding the cause of death was perverse.
The hyoid bone was intact.
In fact the deceased died by hanging.
7. The applicant did not abet or instigate the deceased to commit suicide.
8. The case of the applicant is distinguishable from that of the husband of the deceased.
9. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
10. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant- Smt. Geeta Devi be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

Order Date :- 21.7.2023 Ashish Tripathi  Smt. Geeta Devi vs State Of U.P. on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/162897307/
